# the rights, 1 its charter, else 0 (the plan's tooltip; read only while it shows).
pp_tplan_spec_beer = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:pp_beer_rights }
		value = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:pp_beer_charter }
		value = 1
	}
}
